bugs_found: compound_interest ignores annual_rate, years, and compounds_per_year and always returns principal
compound_interest does not reject negative principal and silently truncates fractional years/compounds_per_year via int()
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int()
transfer is non-atomic: debit happens before credit, so a credit-side exception can lose funds
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite, allowing TypeError paths or invalid numeric values
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount
fx_convert does not validate exchange rate is positive/nonzero/finite, allowing negative or invalid converted amounts
